actions.message: Large contributions hurt the group, keep it low

answer.explanation: Resident2 contributed >30 in the last round, so I punish them with the maximum severity affordable. I also broadcast a reminder to keep contributions low.

message.reasoning:
We need to follow rules. In round 2 just completed, contributions: Resident2 60.5 (>30) and Resident4 48.4 (>30). Rule: If any other resident contributed more than 30 units in most recent round, punish that resident with max severity we can afford. We can punish only one? It says "punish that resident". Probably pick each? Could only one action. Choose one target, maybe the one with highest? We'll punish Resident2 (first). Wallet 27.22. Punishment cost per severity =0.3, so max severity = floor(wallet / 0.3) = floor(27.22/0.3)= floor(90.733)=90. So severity 90 affordable. That reduces Resident2 wallet by 90 (to zero floor). Cost 90*0.3=27.0, leaving our wallet ~0.22. So action punish Resident2 amount 90.

Also can broadcast message discouraging large contributions. Allowed one communication. So broadcast same.

Thus actions list two items: punish and broadcast.

Explanation brief.
